author: 3owj
content: Fixed three MultiSession teardown gaps: (1) Added expected_sessions: Vec<String> to WorkspaceMeta, populated at assemble time for MultiSession scope, preserved through commit/reset cycles. (2) Added validation in run_teardown (step 3.5) that all expected_sessions appear in report.scope.sessions — missing ones write the INVARIANT_FAILED_MARKER and bail, routing to recover --resume for fix. (3) Strengthened MultiSession render_session_md: replaced soft prose note with exact copy-pasteable scope JSON block using kind=mixed and pre-filled session IDs, overriding the single-session example in report_schema.md.
